On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width and full-height uniform lines are the separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    row_groups = []
    start = 0
    for r in sep_rows + [h]:
        if start < r:
            row_groups.append(list(range(start, r)))
        start = r + 1
    col_groups = []
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols + [w]:
        if start < c:
            col_groups.append(list(range(start, c)))
        start = c + 1
    vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in sep_colors]
    background = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    out = []
    for rows in row_groups:
        line = []
        for cols in col_groups:
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in rows for c in cols)
            line.append(1 if count == 2 else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out
